10. Update Corp Card Program to Point to Non-PROD SFTP
Procedure
Navigate to Setup and Maintenance.
Search for Manage Corporate Card Programs.
Open RCSD Corporate Card Program.
Open the Transfer Parameters tab.
Locate the Account Name field.
Add XX to the beginning of the Account Name.
Locate the Profile Name field.
Add XX to the beginning of the Profile Name.
Click Save and Close.
Expected Results
Task completes successfully without Oracle validation or save errors.
